rawContent: A1: As an adult and watching my mother go through breast cancer chemo. Confessing that she just wanted to sleep forever and not fight back. And then, the collective pain of racism through all of the murders of My Peeps #slatespeak #BlackLivesMatter

A2: With regards to #BlackLivesMatter especially with Sandra Bland's murder (Speak Her Name) I realized that my own life was always at risk and I had to always be on guard. We became helicopter parents. #slatespeak
